prompt_head:
Role: Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering
Company: Tebra

<job_posting>
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email

requirements.text: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building scalable distributed systems
Absolute mastery of Java, Spring Boot, and Python for secure, high-throughput, cloud-native backend systems
Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for cloud-native backend systems
2–3+ years of hands-on experience designing, shipping, and maintaining production AI-enabled or AI-native applications
Practical experience with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI)
Deep understanding of RAG, tool calling, prompt engineering, context/state management, and human-in-the-loop patterns
Strong background in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka)
Proven experience implementing enterprise AI guardrails, real-time observability, latency/cost monitoring, automated evaluation pipelines, and fallback mechanisms
Track record of driving technical direction and architecture decisions without formal authority
Excellent cross-functional communication skills bridging Engineering, Product, Design, and Operations
Experience building autonomous, multi-step agentic systems with multi-tier memory networks and recursive reasoning
Background in Healthcare IT, Revenue Cycle Management, billing, claims processing, fintech, or similarly regulated environments
Hands-on experience with vector databases, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge graph construction
Exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, custom embedding models, fine-tuning, or model serving optimization
Past experience as Founding Engineer, Principal Architect, or early-stage platform lead driving AI/ML adoption
